name: lazypowers
description: Instruction-only Product delivery over official Superpowers with singular-result reconciliation and exact Git verification

interface.longDescription: An instruction-only Product workflow over official Superpowers. It keeps Product chat available while isolated task chats execute approved work, reconciles the immutable singular engineering result from transcript-first callbacks, verifies exact Git delivery, and requires a separate Product approval for every external action. It supplies no runtime, daemon, guaranteed heartbeat, or deployment adapter.
defaultPrompt: Use $lazypowers:product to turn an approved Product spec into a singular-result, Git-verified delivery through official Superpowers.
